title: Amount Kept for the Next Installment When a TRICARE Prime Draft Is Weighed
content:
When the account history of a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment shows an excess that would come off a draft through the method on file, part of it stays on the account for the next installment:

- **allotment**, with payments collected through it on the account: two regular installments of that excess are kept;
- **recurring card or electronic funds transfer**, with payments collected through that method on the account: one regular installment is kept;
- **otherwise**: nothing is kept.

What is kept does not come off the draft.

| Hypothetical excess | Method and collections | Regular installment | Kept | Comes off the draft |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100.00 | allotment, collected | 32.51 | 65.02 | 34.98 |
| 100.00 | electronic funds transfer, collected | 32.51 | 32.51 | 67.49 |
| 100.00 | recurring card, nothing collected yet | 32.51 | nothing | 100.00 |
| 20.00 | allotment, collected | 32.51 | 65.02 | nothing (never below zero) |
